evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive asserting authority over what knowledge should be retained or discarded, controlling the informational frame by commanding erasure.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge, exercising positional authority over what information is retained.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority by commanding what knowledge must be discarded rather than by arguing for it?
